name: dog
description: Colorful DNS client with modern interface - supports DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-HTTPS, and JSON output as a user-friendly dig alternative

dog.description: Modern DNS client written in Rust with colorful output, DoT/DoH support, and JSON export - easier to use than dig with intuitive syntax
dog.usage:
dog example.com # Basic DNS lookup
dog example.com MX @1.1.1.1 # MX records via Cloudflare DNS
dog --tls @1.1.1.1 example.com # DNS over TLS
dog --https @cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query example.com # DNS over HTTPS
dog --json example.com A # JSON output format
